author: NBCLA
title: Bus driver fatally shot by passenger in Mar Vista, police say
text:
A bus driver was shot and killed by a passenger in Mar Vista late Thursday afternoon, police said.
A bus driver was shot and killed by a passenger in Mar Vista late Thursday afternoon, police said. The shooting occurred during an altercation between the two people on a Culver CityBus near Mitchell and Centinela avenues around 5:15 p.m., according to the Los Angeles Police Department.
Details about what led up to the altercation were not immediately available. Police say the bus driver, described as a man in his 40s, was taken to the hospital and died. His identity has not been released. The suspect, last seen wearing a white shirt, left on a bicycle, the LAPD said.
No other suspect information was provided. One person was detained, according to police, but it's unclear if that individual was involved in the incident.
"We are grieving the loss of someone who dedicated their time and talents to serving Culver City and who made a meaningful difference through that service every day," Puza wrote, in part.
